chunks: And what will make you know what the Night of Determination is?

key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ: The Night of Decree or Power, a highly blessed night in Islam, often identified as the night the Quran was revealed.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Laylat al-Qadr in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores the ineffable majesty of the night when the Quran was revealed, marking the beginning of divine guidance. Scholars emphasize that its 'thousands of months' of worship signify a period of immense spiritual potency, often linked to the night of the Prophet's birth or the Imamate's establishment, inviting believers to seek nearness to God through deep contemplation and devotion.
